**Finding: compliant (INSURANCE)**

Section 18 of the Brightline agreement already satisfies the preferred playbook position in full:

| Element | Where met |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occurrence | §18.1 |
| CGL USD 2M aggregate | §18.1 |
| E&O USD 2M | §18.1 |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M | §18.1 (unconditional — Vendor hosts Customer Data) |
| Workers' comp as required by law | §18.1 |
| Certificates on request | §18.2 |

Additional terms run in our favour (employer's liability USD 1M, one-year post-term tail, primary-cover, advance notice of cancellation, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities), so no redline was proposed.
